versions.content: The function EthSwt_GetPortMacAddr shall return the port index over which the given MAC-address is reachable within the indexed switch. If for the PortIdxPtr the maximal possible value (255) is returned the given MAC address cannot be reached via a port of this switch. If multiple ports were found the API returns E_NOT_OK .
